from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
root=Path.cwd()
d=root/'reports/research/510300_multidim_treasury_long_supply_cause_score_v1'
assert not (d/'freeze.json').exists() and not (d/'sources').exists() and not (d/'run_started.json').exists()
protocol=json.loads((d/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
inputs=[
'reports/research/510300_treasury_dealer_expectation_source_probe_v1/next_source_question.json',
'reports/research/510300_treasury_dealer_expectation_source_probe_v1/result.json',
'reports/research/510300_treasury_coupon_jan2024_source_qualification_v1/result.json',
'reports/research/510300_multidim_fiscal_deposit_cause_score_v1/protocol.json',
'reports/research/510300_multidim_fiscal_deposit_cause_score_v1/分析程序执行记录.json',
'reports/research/510300_multidim_financing_composition_v1/data_correction/monthly_score/月度事件联合状态及标签.parquet',
'reports/research/510300_multidim_financing_composition_v1/data_correction/monthly_score/逐事件联合评分.csv',
'reports/research/510300_multidim_financing_composition_v1/data_correction/monthly_score/全部固定高分机会.csv']
assert all((root/rel).is_file() for rel in inputs)
stamp=datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
freeze={'registered_at':stamp,'protocol_registered_at':protocol['registered_at'],
'protocol_sha256':hashlib.sha256((d/'protocol.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'before_new_source_fields_or_scores':True,
'registration_repair':'初次注册在依赖文件存在性断言处停止；纠正元数据中的原M2评分文件名，协议、字段、参数和期间不变。',
'input_hashes':{rel:hashlib.sha256((root/rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for rel in inputs},
'authority_config_snapshots':{rel:json.loads((root/rel).read_text(encoding='utf-8')) for rel in ['config/510300_historical_cause_discovery_v1.json','config/510300_existing_data_training_mandate_v1.json']}}
(d/'freeze.json').write_text(json.dumps(freeze,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print(json.dumps({'来源前冻结':'完成','协议未改变':True,'原M2评分及高分窗口依赖已核对':True},ensure_ascii=False))
